//: Capability manifest for <Text> — svelte-pure-admin. See label.map.json for the variant model. Text.svelte renders a bare inline <span> carrying a `.text-{variant}` colour utility (primary|success|danger|warning|info), an optional `title` tooltip attribute, a class passthrough, and a children slot. No variant → class-less <span>. `titleText` maps to the component's `titleText` prop (rendered as the native title attribute).
